statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-53669 (open redirect in react-router) affects >=6.0.0 <7.18.0 and is fixed only in react-router 7.18.0. Trigger.dev's self-hosted webapp is a Remix v2 application whose @remix-run/router 1.x dependency pins react-router to 6.x (resolves to 6.30.4). The fix (7.18.0) is a breaking major incompatible with Remix v2 and cannot be adopted without migrating the webapp off Remix v2, a high-risk change. Tracking upstream Trigger.dev's migration to react-router 7 / Remix v3 and assessing redirect reachability in the self-hosted webapp's route handling.

CVE-2026-53666 (unsafe reflection in react-router) affects >=6.4.0 <7.18.0 and is fixed only in react-router 7.18.0. Trigger.dev's self-hosted webapp (apps/webapp) is a Remix v2 application; @remix-run/router 1.x and @remix-run/react 2.x pin react-router to the 6.x line, so react-router resolves to 6.30.4 (the latest 6.x). The only upstream fix, 7.18.0, is a breaking major that changes the router data APIs and is incompatible with the Remix v2 stack shipped by upstream; adopting it would require Trigger.dev to migrate off Remix v2, which is a high-risk change not yet undertaken. Tracking upstream Trigger.dev's migration to react-router 7 / Remix v3 and assessing whether the affected data-router code path is reachable in the self-hosted webapp.

CVE-2026-53669 requires an attacker-supplied path to reach a React Router navigation mechanism. In Keycloak 26.7.0, admin-console navigation targets come from internal route definitions and route parameters are encoded with encodeURIComponent before generatePath; account-console navigation is derived from the trusted, server-bundled resource content.json and fixed local routes, with the catch-all redirect fixed to '.'. The application does not pass adversary-controlled external paths to the affected navigation APIs.

The upstream advisory limits CVE-2026-53666 to Framework or Data Mode applications performing manual SSR/hydration and explicitly excludes Declarative Mode. Keycloak 26.7.0's admin and account UIs are browser-only applications that call React DOM createRoot and render RouterProvider; their source contains no hydrateRoot, hydration, or React Router server-runtime usage. Keycloak therefore never invokes the vulnerable SSR error-deserialization path.

GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 requires react-router 8.3.0, which is a major version upgrade from 7.x. The vulnerability affects unstable RSC APIs only. Evaluating compatibility and migration path for the major version jump. Current version 7.18.0 addresses other high and medium severity CVEs in the 7.x line.
